title: Sibillant and emphatic:س ش ص ض‎

blocks.text: This unit introduces the emphatic consonants , the most typical characteristic of Arab pronunciation: ⁧ص⁩ and ⁧ض⁩ are the versions of s and d. You learn to produce them and especially to hear them, because the main clue is the color of the nearby vowels. Add Also ⁧س⁩ and ⁧ش⁩ , easy for an italophone but with a trap.

rows: 6 hours · one week at a standard pace

blocks.text: Materials This unit, calligraphy L0-06, Anki deck (tag L0-06), mirror
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize and write ⁧س ش ص ض⁩ in all forms;
2. Explain what emphasis is (tafḫīm) and how vowels change;
3. produce and distinguish s / ṣ, d / ḍ, s / š;
4. always speak deaf ⁧س⁩ , even between two vowels;
5. read, write and translate the words of the vocabulary.
Plan of the week.
7 Correction · Anki
1.1 Two pairs of shapes

• ⁧س⁩ and ⁧ش⁩ : three small teeth followed, in the isolated and final forms, by a cup under the line. ⁧ش⁩ has three points above your teeth. In handwriting, teeth often become a flat line: you will see it in L0-10.
• ⁧ص⁩ and ⁧ض⁩ : an elongated eyelet closed, followed by a small tooth and, in the isolated and final forms, by Cup. ⁧ض⁩ has a point on it.
• Sound. /s/, deaf alveolar Africa.

If you sound it, you'll be able to produce ⁧ز⁩ , that is another letter.
• Examples ⁧سَلَام⁩ salām · ⁧سِجْن⁩ siǧn · ⁧حِسَاب⁩ ḥisāb.
• Sound. /ʃ/, a deaf postalveolar fricativa: the sc of the scene. In Italian between vowels this sound is always Double ('fish') in Arabic it is simple, except with the šadda.
• Examples ⁧شَمْس⁩ šams · ⁧جَيْش⁩ ǧayš · ⁧شُرْطَة⁩ šurṭa (L0-08).

Arabic has four emphatic consonants: ⁧ص ض⁩ (in this unit) and ⁧ط ظ⁩ ed L0-07). Everyone has a simple counterpart: ⁧ص⁩ / ⁧س⁩ , ⁧ض⁩ / ⁧د⁩ , ⁧ط⁩ / ⁧ت⁩ , ⁧ظ⁩ / ⁧ذ⁩ . What changes in the mouth. The tip of the tongue remains at the same point as the simple consonant, but at the same time the root of the tongue withdraws towards the throat and the back lowers and retreats. The mouth becomes a larger and darker resonance chamber. What changes in the ear. Especially the neighboring vowels:

rows: more open and backward, towards [ ɪ ] / [e]

blocks.text: u, ū normal more open, towards [ʊ] / [o]

For listeners, vowel color is the most reliable clue: in ⁧سَدّ⁩ sadd la a is clear, in ⁧صَدّ⁩ ṣadd It's dark. The effect often extends to the whole syllable and sometimes to the whole word. Also ⁧ق خ غ⁩ and, in part, ⁧ر⁩ neighboring vowels darken: for this reason they are sometimes called semi-emphasises. How to train her.
1. S-sa-sa-sa pronunciation with a clear one.
2. Without moving the tip of the tongue, it retracts the root as if to say a wide: ṣa-ṣa-ṣa. The a darkens itself.
3. Do the same with → ḍa.
4. Check in the mirror: with the accents the lips are slightly roundeder and the jaw more Low.
• Sound. /sˤ/, s deaf emphasis.
• Examples ⁧صَبَاح⁩ ṣabāḥ · ⁧مِصْر⁩ Miṣr · ⁧نَصّ⁩ naṣṣ.
• Typical error. Pronouncing it as a normal s and leaving the vowel clear: ṣabāḥ With dark lights.
• Sound. /dˤ/, d sound emphasis.

• Cultural note. Arabs call their own language ⁧لُغَةُ الضَّادِ⁩ luġatu ḍ-ḍād, the language of ḍād• because consider this sound typical of Arabic. In ancient Arabic it was probably a lateral consonant; In the modern pronunciation of the MSA is an emphasis (in part of the Gulf and Iraq it is confused with ẓ).
• Examples ⁧ضَرْب⁩ ḍarb · ⁧مَرِيض⁩ marīḍ (final).
2.3 The four are solar letters
With the article they assimilate: ⁧السَّلَام⁩ as-salām, ⁧الشَّمْس⁩ aš-šams, ⁧الصَّبَاح⁩ aṣ-ṣabāḥ, ⁧الضَّرْب⁩ aḍ-ḍarb.
⁧سَبْر⁩ appears in the expression ⁧سَبْرُ الآرَاءِ⁩ sabru l-ārāʾ • opinion polling; ⁧شَدّ⁩ šadd Threading, tightening, has the same root of šadda, the sign of the double consonant.
⁧ضَرْب⁩ ḍarb shot, hit ⁧ض ر ب⁩ verbal name m.

Notes of use. ⁧شَمْس⁩ šams: Names the solar letters. · ⁧سُورِيَا⁩ Sūriyā: Also ⁧سُورِيَة⁩ · ⁧حِسَاب⁩ ḥisāb: Also profiled on social · ⁧صَبْر⁩ ṣabr: Couple with ⁧سَبْر⁩ sabr \'s survey \' ⁧ضَرْب⁩ ḍarb: Couple with ⁧دَرْب⁩ darb ... path.
